devices.description: Booster pump overload, set to 11.5 A

notes.text: Group 1 breaker raised to 16 A, 1.6 x the 10 A breaker after it, for discrimination.
Booster pump: Ir 11.5 A, the typical Ir of a 5.5 kW motor in ABB Electrical installation handbook Vol. 2 (1SDC010001D0204), §3.3; check it against the nameplate.

params.source: ABB Electrical installation handbook Vol. 2 (1SDC010001D0204), §3.3 Table 3: 400 V 50 kA DOL Normal Type 2

notes.text: Booster pump: dol starter, Type 2 coordination, ABB Electrical installation handbook Vol. 2 (1SDC010001D0204), §3.3 Table 3: 400 V 50 kA DOL Normal Type 2.
Phase imbalance 33.4 % exceeds the company's 10 %: the loads cannot be spread more evenly as given.
Incomer raised to 32 A, 1.6 x the 16 A breaker after it, for discrimination.
Breakers are rated for at least 25 kA breaking capacity against 25 kA prospective at the board; each RCCB's conditional short-circuit current with the breaker ahead of it must reach it too.
Leave 1 spare outgoing ways (20 %).
Loads without a power factor were taken at cos phi 0.9.
Contactors are rated at least their breaker's current (AC-1); confirm the utilisation category against the catalogue for motor or lamp loads.

Each breaker is rated at least 1.6 x the largest breaker after it, so they discriminate on overload. On short circuit, miniature breakers discriminate only up to the upstream breaker's instantaneous trip (about 5 x In for curve C); where total selectivity is required, confirm it from the manufacturer's selectivity tables.

Earth fault disconnection checked from Ze 0.2 Ω at U0 231 V: Zs x Ia <= 0.95 U0, Ia the top of the breaker's instantaneous band (5, 10, 20 In for curves B, C, D), conductors at their maximum operating temperature, protective conductor the size of the line conductors (IEC 60364-4-41 §411.4.4).
Motor starter breakers trip on short circuit only: their Ia is the I3 their coordination table prints, raised by 20 % for the tolerance of an instantaneous release (IEC 60947-2 §8.3.3.1.2).
Each cable's withstand k²S² is in the cable list; compare it with the selected breaker's let-through I²t at 25 kA from its maker's curve (ABB handbook §2.4).
Cables sized for method B1, 30 °C, 1 grouped circuit(s), 70 °C insulation.
Circuit rules are this software's defaults, not confirmed by the company's engineers.
Enclosure: none named, since 3 devices have no width (rail_widths_mm in the company settings).
